newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - TURNOVER DOWN SHARPLY.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - TURNOVER DOWN SHARPLY.

text.p: Exchange fell dramatically last week, down from 3,283,917 to
14,518 shares. Value dropped from 8,134,755 million pula to
Three stocks moved up. Oil company Engen put on five thebe
to 430 thebe, brewery holding company Sechaba was up five thebe
to 250 thebe and miller and food wholesaler Sefalana was up five
Barclays shed 15 thebe to trade at 450 thebe and investment
company Kgola ya Sechaba fell five thebe to 175 thebe.
Untraded were First National, security group Inco, food and
tobacco wholesaler Metsef, clothing chain Pep, variable loan
stock company Real Estate Properties and Standard Chartered.
The index gained 0.25 to close at 354.02 points.
